name: Spluggy Dynamic Pricing for WooCommerce
author: spluggy

sections.description:
spluggy Dynamic Pricing is a powerful WordPress plugin that allows store administrators to create custom dynamic pricing rules for WooCommerce products. With this plugin, you can easily set up flexible discount strategies based on user roles and specific products.

Features

Create dynamic pricing rules
Apply discounts based on user roles
Flexible discount types (Percentage and Fixed Amount)
AJAX product search for rule configuration
Modern and intuitive admin interface
Dynamic rule addition and management
Persistent rule storage
Import/Export rules functionality
Improved modal product search UI
Enhanced admin page design

Requirements

WordPress 5.8+
WooCommerce 5.0+
PHP 7.4+

Usage

Accessing the Plugin

Find the spluggy Dynamic Pricing menu directly in the WordPress Dashboard
Alternatively, use the “Settings” link on the Plugins page

Creating Pricing Rules

Go to Dashboard → spluggy Dynamic Pricing
Click “Add Rule”
Fill in the following details:
Rule Name
Discount Type (Percentage or Fixed Amount)
Discount Value
User Role
Select Applicable Products
Click “Add Rule” to create multiple rules
Click “Save Rules” to store your configurations

Product Search Improvements

Enhanced modal product search UI
Search results appear directly within the modal
Responsive and user-friendly product selection
Supports multiple product selection
Instant search with minimal input

Admin Interface Enhancements

Modern, clean design with intuitive layout
Animated modal interactions
Colorful action buttons
Responsive design for various screen sizes
Improved typography and spacing
Tooltips for better user guidance
Consistent color scheme
Hover effects for interactive elements

Pricing Behavior

Discounts are applied dynamically on:
Product detail pages
Shop/archive pages
Shopping cart
Rules can be specific to certain products or user roles
Supports both simple and variable products
Prevents multiple discount applications in a single cart session
Intelligently handles sale prices
Applies discounts to sale prices when available
Prevents double discounting
Displays original and discounted prices clearly
Shop and archive pages show:
Original price (strikethrough)
Discounted price
Discount label with pricing details
Advanced Variable Product Support
Calculates discounts for all product variations
Displays price range with discounts
Prevents negative or zero pricing
Handles variations with different base prices

Discount Calculation

Percentage Discount: Reduces the price by a specified percentage
Fixed Amount Discount: Reduces the price by a fixed monetary value
The most beneficial rule for a user will be applied
Discounts respect existing sale prices
Ensures minimum price of 0 for all discount types

Import/Export Rules

Exporting Rules

Click the “Export Rules” button
A JSON file will be downloaded containing all your pricing rules

Importing Rules

Click the “Import Rules” button
Select a previously exported JSON file
Rules will be merged with existing rules

Translating the Plugin

Use the spluggy-dynamic-pricing.pot file in the languages/ directory
Create .po and .mo files for your language
Place translated files in the languages/ directory

License

GPL-2.0+

1.0.0

Initial release

1.0.1

WC update release
Dynamic pricing rules
User role-based discounts
Product-specific rules

Email: spluggy0@gmail.com
sections.installation:
Download the plugin zip file
Go to WordPress Admin → Plugins → Add New
Click “Upload Plugin” and select the downloaded zip
Activate the plugin
Navigate to WordPress Dashboard → spluggy Dynamic Pricing to manage rules
sections.faq:
Does this plugin has import/export feature?

Yes, this plugin supports both features

Is possible to add discount in percentage?

Yes, you can add discount in percentage too by mentioning particular value

Is plugin easy for use ?

Plugin is very easy to understand even non-technical person can use this
